symptom: An import-with-mapping activity that passes the mapping's input object (ImportMappingCall.ParameterVariableName) described as `import from mapping M.IMM($json) all;` without it; v0.28.0 refused every rewrite of the flow as "its stored `import from mapping …` activity has no result entity, which Mendix cannot load"; lint CONV020 reported the passed object as never committed; and mxcli itself could not call such a mapping — it wrote an empty ParameterVariableName, which mxbuild refuses with CE0244
cause: The writer hard-coded Commit YesWithoutEvents and ParameterVariableName "", the reader read neither, so nothing above them could carry the object (CONV020's reflective scan never saw the variable name). storedImportWithoutEntity treated any empty result entity as the #1418 unloadable shape, including an unbound result stored as DataTypes$VoidType or with no VariableType, both of which mxbuild loads at 0 errors
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLMicroflow.g4 (importMappingSettings); mdl/visitor/visitor_import_mapping_settings.go; mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_calls.go (addImportFromMappingAction: CE0244/CE0246 refusals), cmd_microflows_format_action.go (formatImportMappingSettings), cmd_flow_modify.go (storedImportWithoutEntity); mdl/backend/modelsdk/microflow_write.go, microflow_read_actions.go (readMappingCall); sdk/microflows ResultHandlingMapping.ParameterVariable/Commit/ResultType
fix: `import from mapping M.IMM($Json) (Parameter: $Obj, Commit: Yes|YesWithoutEvents|No)` — an ADR-0013 settings list after the operand, checked in the visitor; written, read and described; exec refuses a missing parameter on a mapping that declares one and a parameter on one that does not; the splice refuses only an object or list result type naming no entity
insight: No fixture had the shape (PedApp and TestApp hold no import activity with a parameter), so mxbuild was the oracle: build the activity with mxcli, then BSON-edit one property at a time and run mx check — missing parameter CE0244, unexpected one CE0246, undefined variable CE0109, unbound result as VoidType or with no VariableType 0 errors. That last measurement is what showed the 'no result entity' refusal was false: the #1418 guard keyed on the symptom (empty entity) rather than the shape that breaks loading (an Object/List type naming no entity). A lint false positive from a rule that scans every string is a READER bug: the variable name was never in the model
